conflicts.conflict: Realtime admin/users route vs hot-cache/materialized admin user metrics.
conflicts.winningRule: Admin user metrics use hot-cache/materialized snapshots where realtime reads create cost or truth drift.
conflicts.authorityReason: Surface doctrine authority level 4 wins over historical audit commentary.

conflicts.conflict: Preview modal canonical vs full-page locked preview canonical.
conflicts.winningRule: Full-page locked Drop preview is canonical; modal preview is legacy fallback only.
conflicts.authorityReason: Drops surface doctrine and product constitution supersede older duplicated product notes.

conflicts.conflict: Notification opened/read split vs notification_read as one behavioral fact.
conflicts.winningRule: notification_read is the canonical behavioral fact; opened/clicked remain UI diagnostics.
conflicts.authorityReason: Telemetry surface doctrine and source-of-truth constitution define behavioral fact ownership.

conflicts.conflict: Client unlock success counts vs server entitlement truth wins.
conflicts.winningRule: Unlocked counts come from server entitlement facts only.
conflicts.authorityReason: Source-of-truth constitution gives server truth authority over UI display state.

conflicts.conflict: Screenshot detected vs screenshot-like heuristic context.
conflicts.winningRule: Screenshot-like browser/PWA events are weak heuristic context unless confirmed by platform/server evidence.
conflicts.authorityReason: Moderation surface doctrine supersedes legacy wording that implied certainty.

conflicts.conflict: SQL forbidden vs Data Connect allowed mirror.
conflicts.winningRule: Data Connect and Cloud SQL are allowed only as agent-context mirror unless explicitly promoted by contract.
conflicts.authorityReason: Cloud SQL surface doctrine reconciles absolute runtime ban with approved mirror use.

conflicts.conflict: Wallet total balance only vs split free/paid source-aware balance.
conflicts.winningRule: Wallet preserves paid vs reward GumDrop source accounting and source-aware balance display.
conflicts.authorityReason: Wallet surface doctrine and source-of-truth constitution win over old UI density fragments.

conflicts.conflict: Green bonus chip vs purple bonus chip.
conflicts.winningRule: Old green bonus chips are blocked; wallet density uses current brand/source-aware presentation.
conflicts.authorityReason: Wallet surface doctrine and legacy phase-out registry classify green chips as blocked legacy.
